column13: uswin-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=214, epochs=64, batch_size=4, lr=0.0005, uswin_c=24, swin_window=8, swin_heads=4, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1000, seed=42, rationale=ITER-3 (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol). ONE KNOB: epochs 40 -> 64 (1.6x); everything else identical to iter-2 (train_n=200, val_n=214, bs=4, lr=5e-4, uswin_c=24, swin_window=8, swin_heads=4, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=1000, seed=42). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS): (1) TRAJECTORY iter-1 ep10 -> SSIM 0.885910 / hr 0.173021 in 328.96s; iter-2 ep40 -> SSIM 0.914097 / hr 0.322063 in 737.72s. epochs-up lever CONFIRMED (hr +0.149 for +30 epochs, monotone, near-linear). iter-2 used 737.72s = 61pct of the HARD 20-min (1200s) train+score wall -> clear epoch headroom. (2) LIMITER: still UNDER-TRAINED, not capacity/optimization-limited (hr rose monotonically with epochs, no sign of a convergence basin yet; uswin is historically epochs-sensitive, ep10->40 prior run 0.173->0.322). The new ceiling is the 20-min wall, not the optimizer. (3) ONE KNOB = epochs 40 -> 64, justified by timing: from the two measured (epochs, elapsed_s) points the per-epoch cost is (737.72-328.96)/(40-10)=13.63 s/epoch and the fixed cost (data load + 214-slice per-sample val + figure I/O) is 328.96-10*13.63=192.7s. Max epochs that fit the 1200s wall: (1200-192.7)/13.63=73.9 -> 64 predicts 192.7 + 64*13.63 = 1065s = 17.7 min (~135s margin inside the 1200s budget; sbatch wall is 30 min). ep72 would be 1174s = 19.6 min (only 26s margin -> too tight given timing variance), so 64 is chosen as the safe-aggressive count. Train-only = 64*13.63 = 872s < max_train_s=1000 backstop, so the backstop does NOT truncate training. (4) HYPOTHESIS: uswin is still epochs-limited at ep40; +60pct more gradient steps (40->64) lifts hr above the iter-2 0.322063 toward/past dual_domain_supervised (predicted iter-3 hr ~0.37-0.41, extrapolating the iter1->iter2 +0.149/30-epoch slope sub-linearly as convergence approaches). FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr plateaus at or below 0.322 (or drops) at ep64, uswin has reached its training-convergence basin at uswin_c=24 -> it is CAPACITY-limited, not training-limited, and iter-4 must raise uswin_c (24->32) or add an lr-schedule rather than epochs (which cannot fit the wall much beyond 72 anyway). (5) HARD 20-min train+score budget; val_n=214 = ALL L277 slices (NOT reduced); grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory; the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint amplifies gradients). HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps FBP, bg_target=truth, metric=321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; no fov= override). (6) no control return.

uswin-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=214, epochs=34, batch_size=4, lr=0.0005, uswin_c=32, swin_window=8, swin_heads=4, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=900, seed=42, rationale=ITER-4 (search-20260619-01, corrected protocol). ONE KNOB: CAPACITY uswin_c 24 -> 32 (every encoder level widens c, 2c, 4c, 8c; the WindowMSA at each level runs MHA on the wider dim with heads HELD at 4 -> head_dim = 32/4 = 8 valid, 24/4=6 before; uswin_c=32 is in the sanctioned TPE search space [16,24,32]; params ~3.95M -> ~6.9M, a (32/24)^2 = 1.778x conv+attention compute bump), with epochs TRADED DOWN 64 -> 34 to fit the HARD 20-min (1200s) train+score wall. This is the same capacity-for-epochs trade the champion dual_domain_supervised just ran (c16->24, ep27->10). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS). (1) TRAJECTORY iter-1 ep10 c24 -> SSIM 0.885910 / hr 0.173021 in 328.96s; iter-2 ep40 c24 -> SSIM 0.914097 / hr 0.322063 in 737.72s; iter-3 ep64 c24 -> SSIM 0.924443 / hr 0.353196 in 1085.87s (CURRENT, #2 on the Mayo board). current config uswin_c=24 epochs=64. (2) LIMITER: the epochs lever is now BOTH wall-locked AND showing diminishing returns. WALL: iter-3 ep64 used 1085.87s = 90.5pct of the 1200s budget; the iter-3 note computed ep72 -> 1174s = 19.6 min (only 26s margin), so epochs cannot meaningfully rise. DIMINISHING RETURNS: hr gained +0.149 over ep10->40 (+30 ep) but only +0.031 over ep40->64 (+24 ep) -> the per-epoch hr slope is flattening, the c24 net is approaching its training-convergence basin. iter-3's OWN falsifier named this exact pivot: 'if hr plateaus ... iter-4 must raise uswin_c (24->32)'. The new lever is CAPACITY, not epochs. (3) ONE KNOB: uswin_c 24->32, epochs 64->34; ALL else held (train_n=200, val_n=214, bs=4, lr=5e-4, swin_window=8, swin_heads=4, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42). BUDGET-TRADE MATH (worst-case-sized, mirroring the champion's method): from the two measured c24 (epochs, elapsed_s) points (40,737.72),(64,1085.87): per_epoch_c24 = (1085.87-737.72)/(64-40) = 14.51 s/epoch; fixed_c24 (data load + 214-slice per-sample val + figure I/O) = 737.72 - 40*14.51 = 157.3s (predicts ep64 = 157.3 + 64*14.51 = 1086.0s vs actual 1085.87 -> calibration exact). A c24->c32 widening multiplies the U-Net+attention compute by (32/24)^2 = 1.778x; the per-sample 2304-view FBP adjoint is c-INDEPENDENT. WORST CASE (pessimistically assume EVERYTHING incl. the FBP adjoint scales 1.778x): per_epoch_worst = 14.51*1.778 = 25.80 s/epoch; fixed_worst = 157.3*1.778 = 279.7s. Largest epoch count fitting 1200s: (1200-279.7)/25.80 = 35.7 -> ep34 worst-case = 279.7 + 34*25.80 = 1156.9s = 19.3 min (43s margin inside the 1200s budget; sbatch wall is 30 min). ep36 worst-case = 1208.5s BUSTS the budget, so ep34 is the LARGEST epoch count guaranteed to fit even the worst case; epochs is sized to the worst-case bound, not the optimistic one (a wall-bust wastes the whole QOS slot). REALISTIC (FBP adjoint ~30pct of per-epoch, c-independent): per_epoch_real = 14.51*(0.30+0.70*1.778) = 22.42 s/epoch -> ep34 real ~ 243 + 34*22.42 = 1005s = 16.7 min, comfortable headroom. Train-only worst = 34*25.80 = 877s < max_train_s=900 backstop (set to 900 so train always halts leaving >=300s for the worst-case val+figure inside the 1200s budget; iter-3 used 1000 but the bigger net's fixed-cost grew, so 900 is the safe backstop). (4) HYPOTHESIS: 1.778x more representational capacity lifts hr above the iter-3 0.353196 toward/past the champion dual_domain_supervised's 0.365, even at the reduced ep34, because uswin's hr is flattening at c24 (training-basin) yet remains a strong Mayo image-domain denoiser and c32 is its top sanctioned capacity. Predicted iter-4 hr ~0.36-0.38. FALSIFIER (NUMBERS): if hr <= 0.353196 at uswin_c=32/ep34, uswin has hit its representational ceiling on this val set (~0.355) AND/OR ep34 under-trained the bigger net more than the added capacity helped -> iter-5 either (a) keeps c32 and recovers epochs toward the wall if the measured c32 per-epoch is cheaper than the 25.80s worst case (i.e. ep34 left budget headroom), or (b) reverts to c24/ep64 and accepts 0.3532 as the uswin ceiling. (5) HARD 20-min train+score budget; val_n=214 = ALL L277 slices (NOT reduced); grad_clip=1.0 retained (mandatory; the 2304-view Mayo FBP adjoint amplifies gradients). HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps FBP, bg_target=truth, metric=321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; no fov= override). (6) no control return.
